info.name: Get an oEmbed response for a centrexion.com URL

params.name: url
params.description: The URL of the resource for which to fetch oEmbed data.

params.name: maxwidth
params.description: The maximum width of the embed frame in pixels.

items.docs: The oEmbed 1.0 provider endpoint. Returns provider name, title, author, and an iframe embed for any URL on centrexion.com. A URL outside the site returns 404 `oembed_invalid_url`.
